Happy to help! Anything else you'd like to know about ExpertMatch?

ExpertMatch replaces traditional expert networks for PE firms, family offices, consulting firms, and law firms. We find the right practitioners, run the outreach, book the call from your calendar, and bill it to your card. No account managers, no research fees.

responses: Three steps: 1) Describe your research question: sector, geography, and what you need to understand. 2) We find the experts, and our agent Matchy contacts them anonymously on your behalf, handling the conflict and rate conversation. 3) We book the Zoom from your calendar and charge your card when the call ends.

What is the difference between you and expert networks?
responses: Compared with traditional networks: sourcing is automated (minutes vs. a manual researcher), turnaround is under 2 hours (vs. 2-5 business days), outreach and scheduling are handled for you, billing is per-minute and charged instantly (vs. invoice with 30-day net), and you see one rate up front instead of an opaque markup of 3-10x the expert rate.

Pricing is per active seat per month: $250/seat for 1-5 seats, $200/seat for 6-20 seats, and for 21+ seats you'd talk to the team. Every seat bills at the tier your team size falls into, and you can add or remove seats any time (prorated).
